name: Gopāla Cakravartī (tax collector who offended Haridāsa)

fields.place: Saptagrāma (the court of Hiraṇya and Govardhana Majumdār)

fields.aka: Rāma dāsa bābājī (Varṣāṇā), Rameśacandra De (before renunciation)
fields.place: Varṣāṇā (a kuṭīra near Bhānu-kuṇḍa built by the Queen of Tāḍāś; later Loṭana-kuñja)
fields.guru: Initiated in the family of Abhirāma Gopāla (sakhya-rasa); Siddha Jagannātha dāsa Bābājī (rāgānugā bhajana)
fields.notes: Born Rameśacandra De; initiated in Abhirāma Gopāla's family; drawn to rāgānugā bhajana by Siddha Jagannātha dāsa Bābājī (#1828). Did bhajana at Varṣāṇā near Bhānu-kuṇḍa (kuṭīra from the Queen of Tāḍāś), then in Loṭana-kuñja (built by Dr. Bipin Bihārī dāsa). Kept a chopper under his pillow to behead himself if he ever left Mahāprabhu's way of bhajana (Haridāsa dāsa).

fields.name: Svarūpa dāsa Bābājī (Sātāsana maṭha, Purī)
fields.place: Purī: the Sātāsana maṭha near Haridāsa Ṭhākura's samādhi
fields.notes: A blind bābājī of the Sātāsana maṭha near Haridāsa Ṭhākura's samādhi at Purī: kept to his kuṭīra by day, chanted and danced before Tulasī in the evening, bathed alone in the sea before dawn, took only what he needed and advised all to remember Kṛṣṇa's name. (The poet Svarūpa dāsa of the same text has his own record since 11-11-2026.)
